request.style: English, children's Christmas choir, a children's choir with a girl soloist, sleigh bells, glockenspiel, piano and strings, sparkling and happy, 104 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Shepherds in the field at night
Watching all their sheep
An angel came with shining light
And woke them from their sleep

[Chorus]
Glory, glory in the highest
Peace on earth tonight
Glory, glory in the highest
Jesus Christ is born tonight

[Verse]
Do not be afraid, he said
I bring you news of joy
In Bethlehem, a manger bed
Now holds a baby boy

[Chorus]
Glory, glory in the highest
Peace on earth tonight
Glory, glory in the highest
Jesus Christ is born tonight
